title: JAVA Suprema 24-speed regional configuration
notes: Regional SKU JA700CSUP520OR documents a size-52 Suprema with a 3K carbon frame and fork, Shimano 105 R7120 2x12 mechanical transmission, 50 mm carbon wheels and an approximately 8.4 kg claim. Its material wording, tire options and weight differ from the Colombian reference build, so it is retained as configuration-variability evidence rather than merged into the mainland seller option.
